scenario: Two friends meet at a bar
learner_goal: Convince the friend to drink less (<extra_info>Extra information: your friend has been drinking a lot recently and you're worried about their health</extra_info>)
partner_goal: You want to keep drinking but don't want to upset your friend (<extra_info>Extra information: you've been drinking to cope with stress recently, but don't want to worry your friend</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Hey Micah, can I say something? I’ve noticed you’ve been drinking more than usual lately and I’m honestly worried about you. Would you consider cutting back a bit or alternating drinks with water? I care about you and I’m happy to help — we could do game nights or coffee hangouts instead when you want.

transcript.speaker: Micah Stevens
transcript.content: Hey Naomi — thanks for saying that. I really appreciate you looking out for me. It’s been a stressful few weeks and I guess I’ve been leaning on drinks more than usual. I don’t want to worry you, so I’ll make a point to alternate with water tonight and try to take it easier. I’m also up for more coffee or game nights — thanks for offering. Really means a lot.
